supplements.title: The role of prehabilitation in improving brain health and cognition after chemotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer: Study protocol of the Chemo Brain Prehab Project.
supplements.summary: Researchers are testing whether exercise and training before chemotherapy can prevent memory and thinking problems in colorectal cancer patients.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the anticancer effects of ellagic acid and cisplatin in cisplatin-sensitive and -resistant MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Ellagic acid combined with cisplatin effectively kills breast cancer cells by reducing drug resistance and triggering cell death mechanisms.

supplements.title: UHRF1 as an epigenetic therapeutic target in Cancer.
supplements.summary: UHRF1 protein, overexpressed in many cancers, is a promising drug target that could be inhibited to stop tumor growth and restore treatment sensitivity.

supplements.title: Herbacetin alleviates acute doxorubicin cardiotoxicity via regulating the ERK1/2-FOXO3a signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Herbacetin protects heart cells from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage by activating a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Vitamin D inhibits the development of colorectal cancer cells by regulating the gut microbiota and immune microenvironment using JAKSTAT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D reduces colorectal cancer cell growth by improving gut bacteria and immune response through a specific signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Examination of the Effect of Riboflavin on TNF-α, Cas-3 Expression and SIRT1/p53/Bax/Bcl-2 Gene Expression in Diatrizoate-Induced Experimental Nephropathy Model.
supplements.summary: Riboflavin reduced inflammation and cell death markers in a kidney damage model by activating protective genes.

supplements.title: Efficacy of a plant-based diet on FOLFOX chemotherapy-induced gastrointestinal toxicity in patients with colorectal cancer: study protocol for a multicentre, stratified, randomised controlled trial.
supplements.summary: A study will test whether a plant-based diet reduces stomach problems in colorectal cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Feasibility, acceptability and effectiveness of digitally delivered multimodal prehabilitation for cancer patients: A mixed-methods systematic review.
supplements.summary: Digital multimodal prehabilitation (physical, nutrition, psychology) for cancer patients is feasible, acceptable, and improves physical function before treatment.

supplements.title: A tumor-targeting gambogic acid-loaded nanovaccine reprograms the tumor microenvironment for enhanced cancer immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: A nanovaccine combining cancer cell membranes with a traditional medicine compound effectively targets colorectal tumors and boosts immune response.

supplements.title: Weiyan Tongluo Granules attenuate gastric intestinal metaplasia through PPARγ/NF-κB/CDX2 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese medicine treatment reduces precancerous stomach changes by activating a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: The microbial tryptophan metabolite indole acts on the gastrointestinal tract to improve glucose homeostasis in a mouse model of diabetes by enhancing GLP-1 secretion and L cell differentiation.
supplements.summary: Indole, a gut bacteria-derived compound, improves blood sugar control by boosting GLP-1 hormone production in diabetic mice.

supplements.title: Gastroprotective effect of Notoginsenoside R1 On Ethanol-Induced gastric ulcers in Rats via alteration of VEGFR2/ERK and TLR-2/Myd88 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Notoginsenoside R1 protects against alcohol-induced gastric ulcers in rats by reducing oxidative stress and inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Calabanones A‒H, chromanone derivatives from the stem bark of Calophyllum calaba and their cytotoxic activities against cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Eight new plant compounds from Calophyllum calaba showed moderate cytotoxic activity against KB and HeLa cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Dietary patterns and tryptophan metabolism: mechanistic insights and health implications.
supplements.summary: Diet regulates tryptophan metabolism through different pathways, with Mediterranean diet reducing inflammation and cancer risk better than Western diets.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin targets GRP78 to induce dual pathways of ER stress and immune activation in osteosarcoma.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin blocks GRP78 in osteosarcoma, triggering cell death and boosting immune response to fight the cancer.

off_label.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

off_label.title: Cardioprotective effects of prophylactic ACE inhibitors in anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors help prevent heart damage in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy, particularly those also taking trastuzumab.

off_label.title: Targeting the RXR Pathway for the Prevention of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: RXR agonist drugs delayed or prevented triple-negative breast cancer development in mouse models with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: The multifunctional RNA helicase DDX39A drives glioblastoma progression by modulating WISP1 alternative splicing that induces an immunosuppressive macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: DDX39A protein drives glioblastoma growth by suppressing immune cells; blocking it with a drug slows tumor progression.

off_label.title: Ribosomal profiling of the geniculate ganglion identifies the receptor ALK as critical for the development and maintenance of oral sensory neurons.
off_label.summary: ALK protein is critical for developing and maintaining taste buds and oral sensory neurons; ALK inhibitors used to treat lung cancer cause taste loss.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetics of intra-articular delivery of flavopiridol-loaded microparticles reveal sustained effects in Lewis rats.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a sustained-release injection of flavopiridol for osteoarthritis that maintains therapeutic levels in affected joints.

off_label.title: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition restores T-cell homeostasis in primary immune thrombocytopenia.
off_label.summary: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition converts immune cells into regulatory T cells, restoring balance and reducing symptoms in immune thrombocytopenia.

off_label.title: Dasatinib boosts γδ T cell expansion and memory phenotypes with enhanced antitumor immunity.
off_label.summary: Dasatinib drug treatment enhances expansion and anti-tumor function of gamma-delta T cells against glioblastoma and breast cancer.

off_label.title: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting as a strategy to mitigate anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity.
off_label.summary: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting each reduce heart damage from doxorubicin chemotherapy by protecting heart cells and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: cGAS-STING signaling in pollution-induced toxicity: mechanism and relieving medication.
off_label.summary: Environmental pollutants activate a cellular alarm pathway (cGAS-STING) causing inflammation and disease; blocking it may reduce toxicity.

off_label.title: Liposomal Amodiaquine for Localized Therapy of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
off_label.summary: Inhalable liposomes containing an anti-malarial drug showed enhanced effectiveness against lung cancer cells in laboratory studies.

off_label.title: Post-translational modifications of triosephosphate isomerase reveal metabolic vulnerabilities in T-ALL: effect of combining dichloroacetic acid and the PPI rabeprazole.
off_label.summary: Combining rabeprazole and dichloroacetic acid selectively kills T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by targeting a modified metabolic enzyme while sparing normal cells.

off_label.title: Surgically induced necrotizing scleritis after orbital surgery with intraconal tumor excision: a case report.
off_label.summary: A woman developed severe eye inflammation with scleral damage nine weeks after orbital tumor removal surgery, successfully treated with steroids and methotrexate.

off_label.title: The TRIB1-PPARγ Axis Regulates Cholesterol Metabolism in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.
off_label.summary: TRIB1 protein drives pancreatic cancer growth by boosting cholesterol production, and blocking this pathway with statins may treat high-TRIB1 tumors.

biomarkers.title: Optimizing protocols for microRNA profiling of infant and toddler stool.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified optimal methods for preserving and extracting genetic material from infant stool samples for microRNA analysis.

biomarkers.title: The Diagnostic Value of PET/CT and MRI in Head and Neck Cancer of Unknown Primary.
biomarkers.summary: PET/CT and MRI imaging help doctors identify the original source of head and neck cancer when the primary tumor location is unknown.

biomarkers.title: Extracellular heme:DNA complexes promote oxidative stress and inflammation during lupus-associated hemolysis.
biomarkers.summary: Heme and free DNA released during hemolysis combine to trigger inflammation and tissue damage in lupus disease.

biomarkers.title: Neutralization of acyl-CoA-binding protein attenuates glucocorticoid-mediated suppression of cancer immunosurveillance.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking a protein called ACBP/DBI restores cancer-fighting immune responses suppressed by steroids in breast, lung, and skin cancers.

biomarkers.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

biomarkers.title: Effects of Radiotherapy in Normal Tissue.
biomarkers.summary: Modern radiotherapy improves tumor control while reducing side effects through better imaging, planning, and dose delivery techniques.

biomarkers.title: DLST mediates the malignant progression of osteosarcoma cells by regulating the p38 MAPK signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: DLST protein drives osteosarcoma cancer growth by activating the p38 MAPK signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: ALB suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transition and glycolysis via SPARC regulation in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified that ALB protein suppresses tumor spread and energy metabolism in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma through SPARC regulation.

biomarkers.title: Mechanistic insights and therapeutic potential of E3 ubiquitin ligases in gastric cancer development.
biomarkers.summary: E3 ubiquitin ligases control protein breakdown and offer new therapeutic targets for treating gastric cancer.

biomarkers.title: Crohn's disease under single-cell map: from INFLARE metaplastic cells to rare immune cell subpopulations.
biomarkers.summary: Single-cell sequencing reveals novel immune cell subsets in Crohn's disease, offering potential new therapeutic targets.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant Systemic Therapy in Kidney and Bladder Cancer: Current Evidence and Emerging Paradigms.
biomarkers.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy before surgery improves outcomes in kidney and bladder cancer, with immunotherapy showing promise alongside chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Primary Clear Cell Adenocarcinoma of the Female Urethra: A Case Report of a Rare Disease.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors report imaging findings for a rare female urethral cancer, emphasizing MRI and PET/CT's role in diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: Brain and Spinal Leptomeningeal Metastases in Prostate Cancer Detected by PSMA PET and MRI Fusion.
biomarkers.summary: PSMA PET imaging successfully detected widespread brain and spinal cord metastases in a prostate cancer patient with worsening neurological symptoms.

biomarkers.title: Dynamic reprogramming of the tumor immune network via multicycle checkpoint degradation for cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: A new platform called RECYC removes immune checkpoint proteins from multiple immune cells in tumors, enhancing anti-tumor immunity better than current treatments.

biomarkers.title: Structural and mechanistic basis of mTORC2 activation of protein kinase AKT/PKB.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how mTORC2 specifically activates AKT protein, enabling development of targeted cancer therapies blocking this crucial growth pathway.

trials.title: Effects of Radiotherapy in Normal Tissue.
trials.summary: Modern radiotherapy improves tumor control while reducing side effects through better imaging, planning, and dose delivery techniques.

trials.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant Systemic Therapy in Kidney and Bladder Cancer: Current Evidence and Emerging Paradigms.
trials.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy before surgery improves outcomes in kidney and bladder cancer, with immunotherapy showing promise alongside chemotherapy.

trials.title: Dynamic reprogramming of the tumor immune network via multicycle checkpoint degradation for cancer immunotherapy.
trials.summary: A new platform called RECYC removes immune checkpoint proteins from multiple immune cells in tumors, enhancing anti-tumor immunity better than current treatments.

trials.title: Integrated CTC Enrichment and Dual-Responsive Nanoprobe Identification Enable Intelligent Liquid Biopsy-Based Cancer Diagnosis.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new blood test using nanoparticles to identify lung cancer cells circulating in blood more accurately than existing methods.

trials.title: The role of prehabilitation in improving brain health and cognition after chemotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer: Study protocol of the Chemo Brain Prehab Project.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether exercise and training before chemotherapy can prevent memory and thinking problems in colorectal cancer patients.

trials.title: Apoptotic Marker Analysis in Heated-Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy Effluent Fluid Is Associated With Prognosis in Patients With Peritoneal Metastases.
trials.summary: A blood test measuring cell death markers in chemotherapy fluid predicts survival outcomes for patients with abdominal cancer spread.

trials.title: Anti-CD7 fratricide-resistant chimeric antigen receptor T cells for relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Modified CAR T-cells targeting CD7 safely eliminated leukemia in three young patients with treatment-resistant acute myeloid leukemia.

trials.title: Hybrid Community-EHR Approaches to APOL1 Kidney Disease Screening and Clinical Trials among Black Individuals.
trials.summary: A study used community education and screening to identify Black patients with genetic kidney disease for a clinical trial testing a new treatment.

trials.title: Real-World Use of Dostarlimab Plus Chemotherapy in Advanced or Recurrent dMMR Endometrial Cancer: A Nationwide Cohort Study in France.
trials.summary: French study confirms dostarlimab combined with chemotherapy improves outcomes for advanced endometrial cancer with specific genetic markers.

trials.title: Low-flow vascular malformations without arteriovenous shunting of the central nervous system: a pictorial review.
trials.summary: This imaging review describes how to identify four benign brain vascular malformations using MRI to avoid misdiagnosis as tumors or dangerous high-flow lesions.

trials.title: Phase I multi-center clinical and biomarker study of the dual-action androgen receptor inhibitor ONCT-534.
trials.summary: ONCT-534, a new prostate cancer drug, safely reduced androgen receptor protein levels but showed limited clinical benefit in early testing.

trials.title: SPAG5 promotes ferroptosis and enhances chemotherapy efficacy in locally advanced colorectal cancer via upregulating intracellular ROS levels.
trials.summary: SPAG5 protein boosts colorectal cancer chemotherapy effectiveness by increasing cell-damaging reactive oxygen species levels.

trials.title: Multimodal imaging evaluation and management of orbital metastasis: experience at a single institution.
trials.summary: Researchers studied imaging scans to better identify and treat rare cancers that spread to the eye socket.

trials.title: M2pep-modified liposomal nanoparticles delivering siITGB4 induce apoptosis and inhibit NSCLC metastasis via macrophage reprogramming.
trials.summary: Modified nanoparticles targeting lung cancer macrophages reprogram immune cells and reduce tumor spread and growth.
